gameDescriptionHtml:
Welcome to the Wild World of Onirism!

A stolen plushie. A mysterious portal and a girl full of energy and imagination, packed with lots of attitude. Jump into Carol’s slippers and chase the unknown in this fast-paced, dream-like adventure through the world of Crearia!

Game Features

  • Massive Adventure, Endless Surprises – Explore more than 20 unique levels spread over 10 chapters, each packed with secrets, puzzles and bizarre creatures. Platform through candy colored forests, scale the great pyramids, and battle monsters on a mysterious moon base!
  • A Vast Menagerie of Villains – Of course, not everyone you meet wants to be your friend. More than 300 unique enemies await you through your adventure. Each one brings its own otherworldly design and unpredictable behavior, turning every encounter into a surreal challenge.
  • Terrifying Boss fights – But dangerous as they are, those enemies are nothing compared to their leaders. More than 20 bosses seek to end your journey. From sentient carnivorous plants to megalomaniac scientists, you will need every ounce of skill to survive!
  • Weapons, Gadgets, and Potions Galore – Wield over 300 unique weapons and gadgets. Unlock a staggering arsenal of blasters, bubble guns, rocket launchers, and more, each with its own explosive personality!
  • Slay Monsters, Slay Outfits – Fashionably, of Course – Dress Carol in a massive collection of over 200 costumes, from space suits to wacky hats.
  • Fantastical Rides for a Fantastical World – Zoom through stages in the Buzzard Plane, Royal Hovercraft, Mechs, and over 20 more vehicles!
  • Multiplayer mayhem awaits! – Battle it out in local or online multiplayer with friends. Whether it’s blasting each other or taking bosses together, fun is always better shared!
  • The Adventure of a Lifetime Begins Now! – Join Carol on her quest to save her beloved plushie Bunbun as she blasts, jumps, and laughs her way through worlds shaped by imagination. Dive into Onirism today and embrace the chaos of dreams!
